maria: Quick handoff — quant recommendations + batching/cache config for the Optimize toolkit. Need a final owner for rollout and a triage on a regression alert. Pinging @jen and @akash. TL;DR: quant profiles ready (q4_k4, q4_hf), batching rules proposed, nightly eval shows a small accuracy dip on long-context for model-rw-7b-q4hf.

akash: grabbing this. which regression tests failed? link? :eyes:

maria: Nightly eval failure: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/optimize/evals/234 — failing on chat-long-context suite. Repro command below. observed perplexity bump at seq_len=2048 for q4_hf 7b.
```
PYTHONPATH=./optimize pytest tests/evals/test_chat_long.py::test_long_context --max-seq 2048 --model model-rw-7b-q4hf
```

jen: I can take ownership of the canary rollout. Plan: canary = 1% on Dedicated, run smoke + evals for 24h, thresholds: latency p95 < 1200ms and quality drop < 2% (rouge/accuracy proxy). If threshold breached -> auto-fallback to fp16 variant. Will open PR for the canary config.

sam: Batching recs (quick): use dynamic batching with per-model policy. Example policy below — reduces latency for short requests, keeps throughput for longer ones. Also enable prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts.
```
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 8192
  rules:
    - if seq_len <= 256: max_batch_size: 32
    - if seq_len <= 1024: max_batch_size: 12
    - else: max_batch_size: 4
  kv_cache: enabled
prefix_cache: enabled
```

lucy: can you paste expected perf/cost numbers for the q4_hf vs fp16 canary? finance wants a ballpark before EOD.

maria: rough estimate: q4_hf reduces GPU token cost ~30% vs fp16 for steady-state; tail-latency may increase slightly for very long sequences. I'll run a cost calc and post numbers tomorrow morning.

deploy-bot: @jen created canary deployment canary-quant-2026-02-14 id:c-483 -> 1% traffic -> models: model-rw-7b-q4hf

ops-bot: Regression alert muted: alert-3234 (chat-long-context) — assigned to jen, acknowledged.

jen: Thanks. I'll open the rollout PR and tag reviewers @akash @sam @lucy. Expect canary config PR by EOD and a follow-up with canary metrics after 24h.

akash: quick note for profiling: need to run quantized inference profiling focused on KV cache behavior and per-layer runtimes (esp attention kernels). Adding a task to my backlog and will share perf traces.

maria: great. if anyone hits blocking failures while canarying, paste logs here (upload gzipped traces if possible). otherwise let's reconvene async in ~36h to review canary metrics.

sam: LGTM :thumbsup:
